name: self-intro-portal-monorepo
description: Unified Self Introduction Portal (Backend API, Admin Client & Student Web Portal)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin-client && npm install --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:web && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:web && npm run test:admin
scripts.verify:tokens: npm run tokens:check && npm run check:contrast
scripts.verify:all: npm run tokens:check && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:utilities && npm run icons
